description: Answers: Which public companies have disclosed a cybersecurity incident to the SEC? The reply opens with a one-line answer and its date. Breach Clock. SEC 8-K Item 1.05 · every filer · same day. Sourced from SEC EDGAR; every row links to its filing. Free, CC BY 4.0.

limit.description: max rows, default 50, ceiling 200 — the reply carries total/returned/truncated, and `more` links the full board

name: get_breaches
